data.one_liner: Provides CLDR-like currency name translations for 149 locales in pure Dart with zero dependencies.
data.what_it_does: Provides currency name translations for 149 different locales using a single-use locale mapper. It supports tree-shaking via dart-define flags and fallback locales.
use_when: You need currency name localizations across multiple locales without heavy dependencies
You want memory-efficient lazy loading of translation data
avoid_when: You need general-purpose UI currency formatting or currency input masking
You expect mapper instances to be reusable across multiple calls
strengths: 149 locales supported out of the box
Memory efficient with lazy initialization and single-use mapper cleanup
weaknesses: Mapper instances are single-use only and cannot be reused after calling localize()
